name: us-patent-phrase-to-phrase-matching
description: Write a Python fit_predict(train, test_inputs, time_budget_s) function that learns from 39,316 scored patent phrase pairs with their CPC context and predicts the similarity of 9,232 test pairs whose anchors never occur in training, within a 300 s wall-clock budget on 4 CPU threads without pretrained models; scored by Pearson correlation (higher is better).

sources.locator: copy of Google's Patent Phrase Similarity dataset (train, validation and test splits)
Aslanyan and Wetherbee 2022: 48,548 pairs, 973 anchors, anchor-disjoint 75/5/20 split

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: Kaggle dataset access and competition terms
Paper reports gold medal; metric and runtime depend on each competition. Configure competition ID in supplied task config.

Exact metric verified against official MLE-bench grade.py at https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/blob/507f92e1138bb6e40dac5c6ee7a6758e6424bf97/mlebench/competitions/us-patent-phrase-to-phrase-matching/grade.py. This dependency revision was audited; LoongFlow paper did not pin this MLE-bench revision.
